about: DEC-0065: OpenRouter attribution's cases and FAC-SEM-025 over reports, answered by the contract's attributionHeaders and usageRules.

attribution.name: forwarded
attribution.note: a request forwarded for someone else's agent keeps its own attribution

attribution.name: lookalike-host
attribution.note: a lax suffix or prefix match gets this wrong

attribution.name: upper-case-host
attribution.note: WHATWG URL parsing lower-cases the host

attribution.name: title-with-newline
attribution.note: a header value never carries CR or LF

attribution.name: default-port
attribution.note: WHATWG URL parsing drops the default port, so :443 is the same origin

attribution.name: trailing-dot
attribution.note: a fully qualified name with its root dot is another host string

attribution.name: backslash-form
attribution.note: WHATWG reads the backslash as a path separator, so the host is openrouter.ai; an RFC 3986 parser reads another host, and a port follows WHATWG

attribution.name: no-slashes
attribution.note: WHATWG parses a special scheme without slashes as that host; a port follows WHATWG

attribution.name: empty-categories
attribution.note: an empty list sends no categories header
